topFinding: This run's distinguishing contribution is the six-stakeholder-perspective stress test on the March 26 committee output — citizens, MEPs, Council, Commission, third-country trade partners, and EU industry — applied to the Banking Union triple package (TA-10-2026-0090/0091/0092), the Anti-Corruption Directive…

🟡 **US tariff response = threat-with-opportunity** — EU industry defensive necessity + supply-chain pain.
